head: Hills Ahead shows your road trip from the side, hills and all
dek: Hills Ahead draws your car trip as a side view: start on the left, destination on the right, the road rising and falling with the real terrain, and a little car moving along as you drive. It was #59 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: It's made so kids in the back can see how far there is to go. It came out on 6 November and costs $5.99, by Andrew Miller.
means: If "are we there yet?" is a constant, kids can see for themselves.
todo: Find Hills Ahead in the App Store.
